title: Magnific One launches to give teams an image generator that avoids the 'AI look' and automatically upholds their brand kit
key_facts: Magnific announced Magnific One on 8 Oct 2026: an image-generation model that settles an image's art direction before generating it.
Brand Kit launched alongside: an agent extracts a team's logo, palette, typography, imagery and tone from a website, guidelines PDF, images or description; the team reviews it.
Brand Kit takes effect in Final mode, where each image is checked against it; Draft mode returns grids of 4, 8 or 16 directions.
Final images are 2K by default and up to 4K.
Available now on all Magnific paid plans worldwide (web, desktop and mobile apps, and Magnific MCP).
Launch week offer: seven days of unlimited 2K and 4K generation in the desktop app, through 15 Oct 2026.
Magnific is the former Freepik, rebranded on 28 Apr 2026; the company reported one million paid subscribers and $230 million in annual recurring revenue then.
quote_evidence: Magnific on October 8, 2026 announced the launch of Magnific One, an image generation model the company says decides a picture’s art direction before generating it, together with Brand Kit, a companion feature that extracts a team’s visual identity and applies it to the images the model generates.

Magnific One is available immediately on all Magnific paid plans worldwide, on the web, in the desktop and mobile apps, and through the Magnific MCP, which the guide describes as a way to use the model from an AI assistant.
why_it_matters_hint: Teams get an image tool built to keep output on-brand, but the quality claims are the company's.
notes: VentureBeat original returned 429; read Unite.AI instead, which reports Magnific's announcement. Unite.AI's author is labelled an AI-generated research agent reviewed by editors. Claims are the company's own; no outside test.
